description: This file contains utility functions and regular expressions to parse, split, and validate command line strings and executable paths for Windows and other platforms. It is part of a runtime internals module focusing on command-line processing and platform-specific handling.

methods.name: splitCommandParts
methods.description: Splits a command string into individual arguments, respecting quotes and escape characters, considering platform-specific rules.

methods.name: splitWindowsExecutableCommand
methods.description: Analyzes a command string on Windows to determine if it is a direct executable invocation and parses arguments accordingly.

methods.name: assertSupportedWindowsCommand
methods.description: Validates that a Windows command uses supported wrapper scripts or interpreters; throws an error if unsupported.

methods.name: splitCommandLine
methods.description: Main exported function that splits a command line string into command and arguments, handling Windows-specific cases and validation.
